end.summary:
Practised the role of the judiciary and the structure of India’s courts.
Distinguished civil cases from criminal cases using theft, assault, rent, and property-boundary examples.
Explored why police and the public prosecutor represent the wider public interest in criminal cases.
Vihaan described the appeal path from District Court to High Court to Supreme Court; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised identifying civil and criminal cases and explaining the court hierarchy. They used theft to explain why the police and public prosecutor act for society, and later clearly explained a property-boundary dispute as a civil case. At home, ask them to draw the three-level court pyramid and label one example case at each level.
